cards.name: Simian Ancestor
cards.description: When you buff me, ready me.
cards.flavor_text: "I'm faster than I look. Older too, if you can believe it."

cards.name: Heart of Dark Ice
cards.description: Exhaust: Give a unit +3 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text:
"All will knee...in time."
—Lissandra

cards.name: Eminent Benefactor
cards.description: When I hold, play two Gold gear tokens exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: Few things are more costly than free money.

cards.name: Eye of the Herald
cards.description:
[EQUIP Order] (Order: Attach this to a unit you control.)
When I move, play a 1 Might Recruit unit token here.

cards.name: Guards!
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for Rune to react with later for 0.)
Play a 2 Might Sand Soldier unit token. You may pay Order to ready it.
cards.flavor_text:
"My empire lives in every grain of sand."
—Azir

cards.name: Laurent Duelist
cards.description: [ASSAULT 2] (+2 Might while I'm an attacker.)
cards.flavor_text: "No my old foil, this isn't revenge—it's épéeback."

cards.name: Cloth Armor
cards.description:
[QUICK-DRAW] (This has [REACTION]. When you play it, attach it to a unit you control.)
[EQUIP Mind] (Mind: Attach this to a unit you control.)
[SHIELD 2] (+2 Might while I'm a defender.)
Might +2

cards.name: Forecaster
cards.description: Your Mechs have [VISION]. (When you play us, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)
cards.flavor_text: A good mech pilot has quick reflexes. A great one doesn't need them.

cards.name: Sandshifter
cards.description: When you play me, kill an enemy unit with 3 Might or less.
cards.flavor_text: "Recognize your emperor... or the sands will make you."

cards.name: Frigid Touch
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
[REPEAT 2] (You may pay the additional cost to repeat this spell's effect.)
Give a unit -2 Might this turn.
cards.flavor_text: "Freeze."

cards.name: Gearhead
cards.description:
[ACCELERATE] (You may pay 1 and Mind as an additional cost to have me enter ready.)
Each Equipment attached to me gives double its base Might bonus.
cards.flavor_text: "Some people dream about the future. I'm living it."

cards.name: Trusty Ramhound
cards.description: While you have another unit here, I have +1 Might.
cards.flavor_text: It's always best to have a dog in the fight.

cards.name: Wages of Pain
cards.description:
[HIDDEN] (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Deal 3 to a unit at a battlefield. Play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: Smash AND grab.

cards.name: Zaun Punk
cards.description:
You may kill a friendly gear as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, kill a gear.
cards.flavor_text: The Guitar isn't the only thing he shreds.

cards.name: Dropboarder
cards.description: When you play me, if you control two or more gear, ready me.
cards.flavor_text: Piltover prides itself on progress, but the Firelights prove that Zaun is no less inventive.

cards.name: Pickpocket
cards.description: When you play me, you may kill a gear with Energy cost no more than 1. If you do, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavor_text:
"Sticky fingers never linger."
—Pickpockets' motto

cards.name: Blood Money
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
Kill a unit at a battlefield with 2 Might or less. If it was an enemy unit, play a Gold gear token exhausted. If it was a friendly unit, play two BGold gear tokens exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: Even among the unscrupulous, betrayal costs extra.

cards.name: Temporal Portal
cards.description: 1 Rune, Exhaust: Give the next spell you play this turn [REPEAT] equal to its cost. (You may pay the additional cost to repeat the spell's effect.)
cards.flavor_text: Those who study history get to choose whether they'll repeat it.

cards.name: Deathgrip
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve)
Kill a friendly unit to give +Might equal to its Might to another friendly unit this turn. Draw 1.
cards.flavor_text:
"Death is my kindness."
—Mordekaiser

cards.name: Rally the Troops
cards.description:
[ACTION] (Play on your turn or in showdowns.)
When a friendly unit is played this turn, buff it. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 Might buff.)
Draw 1
cards.flavor_text: "DEMACIA!"

cards.name: Renata Glasc - Mastermind
cards.description:
1, Mind: Draw 1.
1,4 Mind, Exhaust: Score 1 point.
Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Progress comes at a price others aren't willing to pay."

cards.name: Renata Glasc - Mastermind (Alternate Art)
cards.description:
1, Mind: Draw 1.
1,4 Mind, Exhaust: Score 1 point.
Use my abilities only while I'm at a battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: "Progress comes at a price others aren't willing to pay."

cards.name: Combat Chef
cards.description: [WEAPONMASTER] (When you play me, you may [EQUIP] One of your Equipment to me for Rune less, even if it's already attached.)
cards.flavor_text: "The tastiest soup is the one you eat after almost getting your head chopped off."

cards.name: Emperor's Dais
cards.description: When you conquer here, you may pay 1 and return a unit you control here to its owner's hand. If you do, play a 2 Might Sand Soldier unit token here.

cards.name: Forge of the Fluft
cards.description: While you control this battlefield, friendly legends have "Exhaust: Attach an Equipment you control to a unit you control."

cards.name: Forgotten Monument
cards.description: Players can't score here until their third turn.

cards.name: Hall of Legends
cards.description: When you conquer here, you may pay 1 to ready your legend.

cards.name: Marai Spire
cards.description: While you control this battlefield, friendly [REPEAT] costs cost 1 less.

cards.name: Minefield
cards.description: When you conquer here, put the top 2 cards of your Main Deck into your trash.

cards.name: Rockfall Path
cards.description: Units can't be played here.

cards.name: Seat of Power
cards.description: When you conquer here, draw 1 for each other battlefield you or allies control.

cards.name: Sunken Temple
cards.description: When you conquer here with one or more [MIGHTY] units, you may pay 1 to draw 1. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ .)

cards.name: The Papertree
cards.description: When you hold here, each player channels 1 rune exhausted.

cards.name: Veiled Temple
cards.description: When you conquer here, you may ready a friendly gear. If it's an Equipment, you may detach it.

cards.name: Direwing
cards.description: I enter ready if you control another Dragon.
cards.flavor_text: A dragon's definition of "prey" is all inclusive.

cards.name: Laurent Bladekeeper
cards.description: [GANKING] (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)
cards.flavor_text: "This old dog has plenty of tricks already."

cards.name: Sea Monkey
cards.description:
You may pay 1 as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, buff me. (Give me a +1 Might Buff if I don't already have one.)
cards.flavor_text:
"Do, monkey."
—Nilah

cards.name: Fae Dragon
cards.description:
When you play me, buff up to four friendly units. (Give each one a +1 Might buff if it doesn't have one.)
When you spend a buff, play a Gold gear token exhausted.
cards.flavor_text: The fae who guard the boundary of the spirit realm take their job as seriously as they take anything.

cards.name: Hexdrinker
cards.description:
[EQUIP Body] (Body: Attach this to a unit you control.)
[DEFLECT] (Opponents must pay Rune to choose me with a spell or ability.) +1 Might

cards.name: Petricite Monument
cards.description:
[TEMPORARY] (Kill this at the start of its controller's Beginning Phase, before scoring.)
Friendly units have [DEFLECT]. (Opponents must pay Rune to choose them with a spell or ability.)
cards.flavor_text: Monuments of magic-absorbing petricite serve both to protect the Kingdom of Demacia and to celebrate it.

cards.name: Show of Strength
cards.description:
[REACTION] (Play any time, even before spells and abilities resolve.)
Draw 1 for each of your [MIGHTY] units. (A unit is Mighty while it has 5+ Might)
cards.flavor_text: Strength in numbers.

cards.name: Akshan - Mischievous
cards.description:
[WEAPONMASTER]
You may pay Body Body as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move an enemy gear to your base. You control it until I leave the board. If it's an Equipment, attach it to me.

cards.name: Karma - Channeler (Signature)
cards.description:
VISION (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 might buff. Runes aren't cards.)
cards.flavor_text: "Endings are beginnings with a different face."

cards.name: Karma - Channeler (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
VISION (When you play me, look at the top card of your Main Deck. You may recycle it.)

When you recycle one or more cards, buff a friendly unit. (If it doesn't have a buff, it gets a +1 might buff. Runes aren't cards.)
cards.flavor_text: "Endings are beginnings with a different face."

cards.name: Yasuo - Windrider (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The third time I move in a turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "I hope you find the path that brings you joy."

cards.name: Yasuo - Windrider (Signature)
cards.description:
GANKING (I can move from battlefield to battlefield.)

The third time I move in a turn, you score 1 point.
cards.flavor_text: "I hope you find the path that brings you joy."

cards.name: Teemo - Strategist (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

When I defend or I'm played from HIDDEN, reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to an enemy unit here for each card with , then recycle them.

cards.name: Teemo - Strategist (Signature)
cards.description:
HIDDEN (Hide now for 1 Rune to react with later for 0.)

When I defend or I'm played from HIDDEN, reveal the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. Deal 1 to an enemy unit here for each card with , then recycle them.

cards.name: Bard - Mercurial (Overnumbered)
cards.description:
You may exhaust your legend as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move any number of your units to an open battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: (Mysterious flower noises intensify.)

cards.name: Bard - Mercurial (Signature)
cards.description:
You may exhaust your legend as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, move any number of your units to an open battlefield.
cards.flavor_text: (Mysterious flower noises intensify.)

cards.name: Mech // Buff
cards.description: A unit may have no more than one buff at a time.
cards.flavor_text: Sure, they're loud, messy, and unreliable. But so are people, when you get down to it.

cards.name: Sand Soldier // Buff
cards.description: A unit may have no more than one buff at a time.
cards.flavor_text: They do not rest. They do not hesitate. And they do not yield.

cards.name: Gold // Buff
cards.description:
Gold Token:
Kill this, Exhaust: [REACTION] — Add 1 Rune. (Abilities that add resources can't be reacted to.)

Buff Token: A unit may have no more than one buff at a time.
